ref_text: EVERY LINE IN WHICH THE MASTER TRACES IT EVEN WHERE SEEMINGLY NEGLIGENT IS LOVELY AND SET DOWN WITH A MEDITATIVE CALMNESS WHICH MAKES THESE TWO ETCHINGS CAPABLE OF BEING PLACED BESIDE THE MOST TRANQUIL WORK OF HOLBEIN OR DUERER
text: Every line in which the master traces it, even where seemingly negligent, is lovely and set down with a meditative calmness, which makes these two etchings capable of being placed beside the most tranquil work of whole-bine or dure.
